tasks.details: Create src/transport/llmTransport.ts with abstract provider interface. Implement: OpenAI provider (openai.ts), Azure OpenAI provider (azure.ts), LM Studio provider (lmstudio.ts). Add retry policy (exponential backoff), rate limiter, streaming response buffer, token counter using js-tiktoken. Support both chat and completion endpoints.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for each provider with mocked responses. Integration tests with real endpoints. Test retry logic with simulated failures. Verify token counting accuracy. Test streaming response chunking.

tasks.title: Implement prompt caching with TTL and LRU eviction
tasks.description: Create a prompt caching and history system that stores LLM interactions for context reuse. Implement memory management with size limits, TTL support, and efficient retrieval by task/agent.
tasks.details: Create src/llm/promptCache.ts with LRU cache and TTL support. Store cache as JSON in workspace. APIs: cache(key, payload), retrieve(key), evictByAge(ttlMs), clear(). Support compression for large payloads. Add cache statistics (hits, misses, size).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for cache insertion, retrieval, eviction. Test TTL expiration. Test LRU eviction when limit reached. Verify workspace file I/O. Test compression on large payloads.
